scope: Local PostgreSQL synthetic historical financial-numbering integrity; no commercial/production qualification

checks.original_policy_rotation_repro: FAIL before correction; PASS after correction

rollout: Keep financial writes disabled/free until all writers use the new schema/code; legacy code cannot identify explicit prefix rows correctly
